input: Eid ul-Fitr, Bakrid, Milad un Nabi, Muharram are celebrated by Muslims whereas Christmas, Good Friday, Easter are celebrated by Christians in the state.

input: Mahamagam a bathing festival at Kumbakonam in Tamil Nadu is celebrated once in 12 years.

input: Aadi Perukku is celebrated on the 18th day of the Tamil month Aadi, which celebrates the rising of the water level in the river Kaveri.
output: आदी पेरुक्कू तमिल महिना आदिको १८ औं दिनमा मनाइन्छ, जसमा कावेरी नदीमा जलस्तरको बढाइको गुणगान हुन्छ।

input: Most of these festivals are related to the goddess Maariyamman, the mother goddess of the rain.

input: During this final day, Kaanum Pongal – the word kaanum, means 'to view' in Tamil.

input: The first month in the Tamil calendar is Chittirai and the first day of this month in mid-April is celebrated as Tamil New Year.
